original: Students must maintain at least 75% attendance in every course. Students below 75% attendance cannot appear for the end-semester examination unless the HOD approves. Medical leave is counted only if a certificate is submitted within 3 days. Parents will be informed of any shortfall.
rewritten: Every student must keep 75% attendance in each course. Students below 75% attendance cannot appear for the end-semester examination. Medical leave counts if a certificate is submitted within 5 days. Late arrivals may be marked absent.
